notes: Scope: 10 business data flows, 55 CRM SDK writer components (16 distinct entries in crmWrites incl. identicalCopies). Out of scope (ETL plumbing, not mapped): the 10 'Insert Etl process warning' OLE DB Commands (direct SQL INSERT into gen_etlprocesswarningBase on the CRM DB connection — Unsupported DML but plumbing), 'End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish' (gen_etlprocess), 'Create ETL Process record', 'Write to ETLProcessCounter' tasks, Component Task Name, Row Count, Error outputs.

Source columns: every writer input originates in an OLE DB Source SQL with JOINs/temp tables on the CRM DB (connection CRM → psql / ALTSHULER_MSCRM); the lineage tool marks them sql-expression. The exact table.column (and aggregation) is given in each attribute's expression. declaredRowFilters use file = 'CRM' (the OLE DB connection) and field = table.column, and include the SQL WHERE/HAVING predicates as well as the script filters, because compose only shows automatic Conditional-Split filters that carry file fields (none in this package).

FINDING (Create CP for Fund With FT 56): sub-query ft is a UNION ALL of the gen_ftcurrentyear and gen_ftpreviousyear per-fund aggregates without re-aggregation. A fund with qualifying type-56 transactions in both tables yields two source rows for the same (transfer-in, fund) → two gen_coursepartition records are created in the same run (the 'cp.gen_coursepartitionId IS NULL' guard only protects later runs). If a customer account has several open type 1/7 transfer-ins, each fund is also paired with each of them (one course partition per pair). DTSX 46144.

FINDING (Create CP for Fund With FT 56 \ Update Transfer In): it is fed from the synchronous 'Result' output of the SDK create writers, so gen_transferin.gen_actualtransferdate / gen_arrearsinterestamount / gen_arrearsdays are updated even when the gen_coursepartition create failed. gen_actualtransferdate here is NOT passed through Dates To Local, whereas Close TI internal/external convert the same attribute → inconsistent time-zone handling of gen_transferin.gen_actualtransferdate across flows.

FINDING (Close TI internal): gen_modifiedByBank is not an input of 'Dates To Local' (DTSX 23966) while gen_actualtransferdate and gen_modifiedbybankDB are converted; the writer therefore writes the unconverted (UTC) date and compares it with a local-time DB value. Depending on how CRM.Proxy/SDK treats DateTimeKind.Unspecified, this either shifts gen_modifiedbybank or makes the comparison differ on every run (unverified at runtime). Close TI External converts all three consistently.

FINDING (EntityReference logical names): 'Create CP - Joining Only' writes gen_customername = EntityReference("gen_transferin", <contact id>), gen_product = EntityReference("gen_coursepartition", <product id>), gen_agent/gen_agency/gen_consultingbankname = EntityReference("gen_fundmain", ...), gen_supervisor = EntityReference("gen_agentcontract", ...); 'Create TI - Joining Only' writes gen_contactname, gen_accountname and gen_automatedjoining as EntityReference("gen_customeraccount", ...). The FT56 writer uses contact/product/gen_agents/gen_agencie/systemuser/account for the same gen_coursepartition attributes. Whether CRM rejects or ignores the mismatched LogicalName is runtime-dependent (unverified).

FINDING (gen_coursepartition.gen_creationdate): FT56 writer writes Gen_fundmain.CreatedOn (record creation date) guarded by gen_fundcreationdate IS NOT NULL (main.cs:41-42), while 'Create CP - Joining Only' writes Gen_fundmain.gen_fundcreationdate to the same attribute.
FINDING: 'Create CP - Joining Only' writes gen_agency only when gen_agentname is NULL (else-if, main.cs:57-60); the FT56 writer writes both independently.

Close TI internal/external: gen_currentstateDB is always 1 (SQL WHERE ti.Gen_CurrentState = 1), so gen_currentstate = 3 is written for every closing-branch row; not-to-close rows (internal: gen_actionstatus 22) stay open and are re-evaluated on every run. Close TI External split compares the raw (UTC) dates before Dates To Local.

Update TI - first transaction (53): gen_actionstatus = 12 is always set, so the NoNeedToUpdate path is dead code. The current-year branch of its SQL joins gen_fundmain, the previous-year branch does not (no effect on values).
Update CoursePartition internal SQL declares @PeriodOfTimeToCheck = 30 but never uses it (literal windows 0..5 / 0..1 days); external uses @PeriodOfTimeToCheck = 0.

Sibling differences (not in dupes.json): Clone TransferIn 1 vs 2/3 vs 4/5 — only output order; Update CoursePartition internal 1 — only output order; Update CoursePartition internal 2 — method name ExecuteBulk vs ExcecuteBulk; Update TI - first transaction (53)\Update TransferIn By Transaction 1 — only output order. All analysed and listed as separate crmWrites.

Clone TransferIn: SQL uses unqualified Gen_customeraccountid (ROW_NUMBER partition and select list); mapped to the new Gen_customeraccount ca — the CRM schema is not supplied (external_unknown) but Gen_transferin rows are joined only through gen_customeraccountdest. Unguarded Row.X reads (no _IsNull test) throw on NULL in the SSIS buffer accessor → Error output, no create (standard PipelineBuffer behaviour, not verified at runtime).

CRM.Proxy (CrmProxy, ExecuteMultipleExtension) is an external assembly not supplied (blocked_external_dependency): batch semantics (ContinueOnError, ordering) are unknown; the SDK target is Variables.ServerName / OrganizationName (set by plumbing data flows). Script analysis is on the embedded C# source; DLLs not decompiled.

UNVERIFIABLE RISK (Create CP - Joining Only, DTSX 42623): the CP2 test ((CP2.gen_fundnumberdest = FM.gen_fundmainid AND the products differ) OR CP2.gen_coursepartitionId IS NULL) is evaluated per joined CP2 row, not as NOT EXISTS. For a transfer-in that already has several course partitions this can yield extra rows for the same (joining partition, fund), so partitions may be duplicated or re-created on later runs. Later rows are appended and the whole list is sent again (Count == 10 is not hit again, so the resend happens at end of rowset). The batch may therefore be resent and records created twice.
